# Zero Learn — learn.joinzero.ai

> Zero is the simulator where students do real work for real companies, get scored against the top 1% of professionals, and get recruited based on receipts. Free for students. Recruiter-paid.

> This subdomain (learn.joinzero.ai) hosts Zero's educational content: cornerstone answers to student career questions, honest competitor comparisons, scoring methodology, and receipts. The main marketing site is at joinzero.ai.
